name: Bases Gained per Opportunity
formula: ({Running (Retrosheet): SB} + {Running (Retrosheet): 1st to 3rd on Single} + 2*{Running (Retrosheet): 1st to Home on Single} + {Running (Retrosheet): 2nd to Home on Single} + {Running (Retrosheet): 1st to Home on Double} + {Running (Retrosheet): 1st to 2nd on Fly Out} + 2*{Running (Retrosheet): 1st to 3rd on Fly Out} + 3*{Running (Retrosheet): 1st to Home on Fly Out} + {Running (Retrosheet): 2nd to 3rd on Fly Out} + 2*{Running (Retrosheet): 2nd to Home on Fly Out} + {Running (Retrosheet): 3rd to Home on Fly Out}) / ({Running (Retrosheet): Steal Opportunities} + {Running (Retrosheet): Extra Base Opportunities} + {Running (Retrosheet): Tag Up Opportunities})
